about: The area config for one study round over R&D (#8005 slice 5; docs/IA.md §5.4: the market calendar, the house's calls and their write-ups, the closures, Coverage across the sectors, and the playbook catalog with a member's own playbooks, chains and stated views — /app/research and its Board, Coverage and Playbooks sections). Read by scripts/study/round.mjs; everything area-specific lives here or in scripts/study/worlds/rd-*. Worlds, all on the pin's Monday of Thanksgiving week with the pin as corpus: rd-today (the league as it stands; the owner's bot's CRWV wheel steered by the house's AI-dip view), rd-own-views (the same day after the owner stated a view of his own on that pair and drafted a playbook of his own: the two meanings of 'conviction' on one page) and rd-first-day (a member who linked a paper account this morning: no bot, nothing written). Phone first: the profile readout put every give-up on a phone, so 7 of the 10 frames are phones. Members start where the app nav's R&D link lands. Census routes are links the app builds (a call's write-up, a playbook's study), never composed. `roles` is who each member is here, in plain words, read by the experts and the words pass instead of the cards (#5099), so it never quotes a card. No sealed key, framer or tasks yet: those come when the cross-feature round clears (#8005).

matrix.note: his own stated view and his own draft playbook sit beside the house's view that steers the same pair
owns a small account and a bot of their own; the catalog's + subscribes only their bot
owns nothing: Coverage has no account to price from and Playbooks has no bot to subscribe

roles.eric: Runs the league and owns one of its two bots; reads the house's research to decide what his bot should run and what he believes about the market. On a phone when away, at a desk at home.
roles.returning-trader: Has one paper account and some options vocabulary, and is back after some weeks away; wants to know what is coming up in the market this week and what the house thinks of it. Uses a phone and a desk.
roles.phone-only: Uses the app only on a phone, one-handed, a minute or two at a time.
roles.invited-friend: A friend the owner invited, with one small account and a bot of their own; reads the research to pick what their own bot should run. On a phone.
roles.bot-watcher: Owns no account at all; follows what the league's bots run and why, and reads the research behind it. On a phone.
roles.first-timer: Invited last week and linked a paper account this morning; owns no bot and has written nothing yet. On a laptop.

pages: a calendar of the market's days, with a lens from one day to a quarter, the closed days and early closes marked, steering everything below it
the house's calls for the days in view, each opening its own write-up, with filters by kind of event, impact and call
the names the research covers, each with its next dated event, and one name picked to narrow everything to it
the event write-ups and longer studies, each on its own page with a way back
where the research reaches across the market's eleven sectors, with each sector's month against the market and a tap to see its research
a catalog of strategies a bot can run, each with its evidence, how it trades, and a way to subscribe one's own bots
a member's own playbooks, drafted, tested without trading, then switched on
a member's own stated views of the market, as claims that can each be proved wrong, which can be handed to their bots to steer what they run
where these pages send the member next: each write-up and study on its own page, and the way back to the board
